# DockBot

> Free, open-source native Windows dock and local intent assistant.

DockBot runs on Windows 10 and Windows 11 with .NET Framework 4.8. Its approximately 17 KB local intent model works with application matching and rules to manage a Windows desktop. It is not a general-purpose language model.

Features: glass dock, application drag and drop, categories, natural-language application management, saved workspaces, Ctrl + Space search, and desktop cleanup with confirmation. Local intent recognition requires no paid model API. Optional usage records and configuration are stored locally.

License: MIT. Author: nanhudev. Current builds are preview releases.
